evidenceBoundary.direct: On the selected native bodies, the named methods use the MapConfig JSON and streaming-asset path literals; load, cache, and pass a MapConfig through both pipelines; read the streaming asset path, store its load result in the scene's typed field, read its scene name, and initialize a DynamicStreaming base path. The selected main, init, streaming, and version path bodies name their file templates; the typed FlatBuffer loader calls the VFS low-IO reader and checks chunk versions. The area dealer loads a typed FBStreamArea root, builds trigger mappings and a query tree, seeds its active set from RootVisible, and consults area visibility spans on updates. The shared dynamic-property component body creates a component blackboard, loads template properties, and adds it under the component key; its init body passes instance data and the component blackboard through the selected ApplyProperties virtual slot, which both portal data classes override. The logic-ID interactive lookup passes its selected LevelInteractiveData out slot into InteractiveInfo, which stores that level data on BaseEntityData before commit and node construction. On the selected node pipeline spawn branch, the node reads the stored level data and forwards it through both ObjectContainer stack arguments into the ordinary EntityAllocator overload; that overload assigns placed LevelData before pre-initializing components. Entity.Init enters ComponentContainer.Init, whose body calls BaseComponent.Init. The node dependency-group getter reads the stored LevelEntityData ID. SetInAoi tests that ID; its zero-group branch maps a true AOI flag to the selected Intrested enum member. A named grid processor passes its node and AOI Boolean to an unnamed native setter with the same checked group lookup and state mapping. NodeGrid has force-load entry and grid-range exit calls to that setter; the skip-AOI handler selects the force-load branch. SetAoiState checks that state before launching the pipeline; SwitchToNextPipelineState can enter the spawn branch. Dependency-group admission instead assigns NotIntrested until an interested group transition changes the member state, and the spawn queue has a separate pipeline-entry body. The interactive root reads the LevelInteractiveData component override map, enumerates its keys, and loads selected property rows into a ParamBlackboard; each portal data getter returns its selected enum member and each ApplyProperties binds tp_position to a Vector3 callback. Squad teleport and portal component-data positions reach the regular and seamless loading centers; their selected steps pass those centers to the base scene, and extra loading can provide an optional area sub-center. The dealer assembles its center list before querying. The base scene flushes the active set and sends changes to engine and DynamicStreaming area routes. Condition classes, selected enum defaults, and body hashes are also checked.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Cache misses, successful lookups and asset loads, map-ID changes, variable availability, listener registration, valid streaming scenes, teleport and portal entrypoints, successful interactive lookup, node creation, a grid AOI-interest update or runtime force-load selection, node readiness, a selected spawn pipeline state, unpatched entity methods, center updates, and non-null scene systems select the observed branches. The contract does not assert that a particular grid, area, or entity executes them.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: A generic field-offset match alone does not prove the receiver object. The shared asset loader pointer is instantiated as System.Object and does not prove its target class. The dynamic-property component body is also shared under System.Object, and its data-application dispatch helper is unnamed; the concrete portal inheritance is checked by the separate portal join. The indexed RootVisible getter in _BuildMapping is an unnamed native clone, and simple call/read claims do not independently prove its full output-to-set dataflow. The checked grid callers reach an unnamed body with equivalent group/state behavior rather than the named SetInAoi entry; other callers of that named entry are not classified. They do not prove that an observed portal node received a grid AOI update or reached the spawn state, the origin of a squad teleport position, that a particular stored portal override populated a live component-data value, condition truth, a selected live scene, active-set contents, or the CheckInArea geometry predicate. The selected Single comparer tolerance and compound-condition Boolean branches need reinspection if their body hashes change.
